title: Wooden mirror
blurb: I built Daniel Rozin's 1999 Wooden Mirror as a GPU shader driven by a live HTML form through texElementSubImage2D(). Up to 1,764 physical tiles tilt toward an overhead spotlight from sampled luminance, with zero CPU pixel readback.
question: Can I transform a live editable HTML form into Daniel Rozin's 1999 motorised Wooden Mirror sculpture, tilting 900 physically shaded 3D wooden louvers in real time on the GPU with zero CPU readback from texElementSubImage2D() luminance while keeping the controls clickable via updateElementGeometry()?
